mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_api_credential (credential_id, merchant_id, app_key, secret_cipher, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{credentialId}, #{merchantId}, #{appKey}, #{secretCipher}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE secret_cipher = VALUES(secret_cipher), status = VALUES(status), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
